project_title: Lead Clipper to Lead a Clipper team

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text:
Before anything else, Nikhil, I owe you an apology for taking so long to respond. Although we had already made our selections, many applicants who were not chosen continued contacting us, and some even offered to work for free just to get an opportunity. I needed to address that properly and respectfully before giving my full attention to the twelve of you we are moving forward with.

You can also be assured that a ticket will be created for you before the deadline, securing your place and ensuring you are paid on time. There is no need to worry about that.

Here is where things stand now:

The group we are building is our first core team. This is more than twelve hires; you are the founding group. As we progress, top performers will move onto our CPM based pay structure and receive bonuses. From this group, one person will step into the Lead Clipper role. That responsibility includes leading the team, approving clips, managing the other clippers, and receiving a stable salary with bonuses on top. The opportunity remains open, and consistency and results will determine who earns it.

Your next steps are as follows:

Before editing anything, carefully review everything in the Notion brand guidelines, including the editing style, hooks, subtitles, and material that must never be clipped. Arden’s personal welcome video is currently being added alongside example videos. Check back later today so you can hear his explanation of the vision behind all of this directly.

After reviewing the guidelines, begin creating your clips. Doing so is what takes you beyond the Upwork trial phase and into the real system.

Additional training resources are still being added to the Notion, so continue checking it as they become available.

I’m excited to have all twelve of you secured. Let’s make sure we build this properly.

— Darius
Audience Production Lead at Emberframe Studio

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hello, how's it going?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: To demonstrate the quality and consistency I can contribute to the team, I’m ready to complete the 6-clip trial.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Nikhil,

Your detailed introduction checked every box, and your profile matches exactly what we need: manual editing, the right tools, strong volume capacity, and a long-term mindset.

Before anyone moves into the full contract, we follow the same standard onboarding process regardless of experience. Every clipper begins with a first paid milestone of 6 clips so we can confirm alignment on style and brand standards.

Please complete these steps:
1\. Review the YouTube channel and Instagram account I will share with you
2\. Create 6 clips using that content
3\. Submit them by Thursday

Approval of your clips will trigger a video call, during which I’ll walk you through the full system: your daily task board, the payment dashboard that lets you track earnings daily, your assigned Instagram account, and everything else you need to hit the ground running.

The pay structure is:
— $7.50 CPM per 1,000 views
— $1200 maximum payout per clip
— Weekly and monthly performance bonuses

To be direct, the Lead Clipper path is very much on the table as you grow with us, especially given your volume capacity and the leadership mindset you already demonstrated in your message.

Confirm that you’re ready, and I’ll send the links now.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: <https://video.emberframe.example/@ardenvalevideo>

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I’m grateful for the opportunity and the thorough explanation of how the process works.

After reviewing the content carefully, I’ll complete and submit the 6 paid trial clips by Thursday. I’m ready to move forward.

The transparency regarding the system, payment structure, and opportunities for growth within the team is appreciated. I look forward to learning more about the workflow and contributing to the brand’s long-term success.

Once you send the YouTube and Instagram links, I’ll get started right away.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Perfect Nikhil — welcome to the trial.

Here are the links:

YouTube: <https://video.emberframe.example/@ardenvalevideo>

Go through the content, find 6 strong moments with good hooks, and clip them. No specific topic needed — just show us you can find a great moment and edit it cleanly.

Deadline is Thursday. Looking forward to seeing your work.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Thank you—I have the link. I’ll begin reviewing the content right away, then select 6 strong moments with compelling hooks and turn them into clean, engaging short-form clips.

Everything will be ready and submitted before the Thursday deadline.

I’m looking forward to showing you my work.

Best,
Nikhil

I'd appreciate your feedback, including any adjustments you'd like me to make. I look forward to hearing your thoughts and discussing the next steps.

Best,

messages.text:
Hey Nikhil ,

First — your submission was good. You made it through and you're in.

We're currently finalizing the onboarding system on our end — training material, brand guidelines, and a full breakdown of exactly what we're looking for in every clip. We want to make sure that when you start, you have everything you need to hit the ground running the right way.

Sit tight. I'll be reaching out shortly to book a call so we can walk you through everything before you start clipping.

Appreciate your patience. This is the beginning of something real.

— Darius

messages.text:

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please do not worry, sir—tomorrow I will send you the next steps. We are currently finalizing the clipper's guideline and configuring your automated payment tracker. Rest today, and you will hear back from me tomorrow.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please just call me bro, not sir 😊 Thank you so much again.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Are there any updates for me, Darius? Also, how have you been?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Team-Building Update — Our Selection Process Is Changing

We received an overwhelming response to this role, with many people repeatedly returning to show their interest. Because of that, we’ve revised how we select the team.

A pre-call screening form will now replace the trial clip. This approach allows us to assemble the strongest possible crew from the outset—people who are the right overall fit, rather than simply the right editors.

What happens next is straightforward: complete the form below, and we will review every submission. Passing means immediate admission to the team, along with the full guidelines, account access, and a configured payment tracker so you can begin earning right away.

There is no trial and no waiting around. You submit the form, we make a decision, and then we move forward.

<https://notes.emberframe.example/p/editorial-dashboard-4827?pvs=204>

Capacity is limited because we are not trying to create a large crowd. The goal is a small, high-output crew. If you have continued showing up and replying consistently, this is your opportunity.

Complete the form now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I've submitted the required screening form.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Nikhil,

You’ve been selected as one of the top 12 applicants moving forward. Over 90 people applied for a place on this team, and after carefully reviewing every application, we chose only the highest-ranked candidates.

Your selection was not a coincidence. Your application stood out, and we believe you can contribute to something that has the potential to grow into a significant operation.

I also want to apologize for the delayed response. We needed a call with Upwork to ensure everything was set up correctly, including a proper contract structure that protects both you and us before we proceed. That is the standard we expect from ourselves.

The trial will work as follows:

Using Arden's content, you’ll create 30 to 40 clips according to the brand guidelines already shared in the Notion workspace. Compensation is a flat $4 per clip. If your quality remains strong and consistent, you’ll also receive a bonus, with no cap on what good work can earn.

After all the clips are finished, submit a milestone on Upwork; payment will then be released. The process is simple, clear, and protected for both sides.

Top trial performers will move in-house under a performance-based compensation model that includes bonuses. That is where the greater earning opportunity begins. Consistent delivery can also open a leadership path within the operation, including a base salary and responsibility for managing a team.

What we are building is real, and those who move quickly and execute well will benefit most from joining early.

Are you in?

— Darius
Audience Production Lead, Emberframe Studio

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Darius,

I’m in and ready to begin. Before completing the trial clips, I’ll carefully review the brand guidelines, and I’ll put my best effort into every clip.

Thank you for the clear update and for selecting me among the top 12 applicants. I appreciate both the opportunity and the transparency around the process. I’m looking forward to working with the team and demonstrating what I can do during the trial.

Best regards,
Nikhil

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Before I begin any trial work, Darius, could you confirm that the Upwork contract and milestone will already be active and funded? I’m excited to start, but I want to ensure the setup is complete first so that both sides are properly protected.

Thank you.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Nikhil,

Please create the contract ticket on Upwork now, and then you may begin working. You are fully protected here, so there is no need to stress.

I have a call with Arden today, and I will get back to you right after it. The milestone will be funded by tomorrow at the latest—you have my word on that.

Neither we nor your payment are going anywhere. We brought you aboard because we want a long-term working relationship with you; this trial is only the beginning.

Get started, and I’ll be in touch following my call.

— Darius
Audience Production Lead, Emberframe Studio
